description:
มุน 2026-07-28: Zone 6 เรียนปาจื่อ (Figma 375:14147) REUSES the shared (375:14151 === Zone 4 333:6889) — the card, its 2 mascots, book-frame, and 3-piece cohort motion are all already anchored by run-zone4-motion.ts, so run-zone6-pajeu.ts deliberately does NOT re-litigate them. What it owns is the ways a copy-paste of Zone 4 would silently be WRONG for Zone 6 (className passes, pixels lie): (1) cta-variant — Zone 6 uses the TERTIARY CTA (bordered, transparent fill, sapphire text, 'ดูรายละเอียดเพิ่มเติม') NOT the primary filled ซื้อเลย pill — read from computed style (borderWidth>=1 + backgroundColor transparent), not the className; (2) no-3-card-row — Zone 6 has ZERO pastel-blue property cards (Zone 4 has three) — a stray/duplicated row is invisible to tsc; (3) title-2-line — the title is 2 lines in the 140-tall text box, verified by rendered height / line-height (a missing
collapses to 1 line and reflows the card); (4) asset-fidelity — both mascots paint here too (naturalWidth>0); (5) motion-in-context — the shared cohort classes actually ATTACH a running animation in the เรียนปาจื่อ section (getAnimations playState running), proving the reuse is LIVE not decorative. Two HabitCards now coexist on /v2 (Zone 4 + Zone 6); every anchor scopes to its section by heading text, so run-zone4-motion/-sian stay green with Zone 6 present (verified — no cross-contamination). Teeth: mut-cta-filled (strip border + fill the CTA -> cta-variant gate rejects) and mut-card-row (inject a pastel-blue card -> no-3-card-row gate rejects), both CAUGHT. Fidelity vs Figma 375:14147 confirmed by rendered-vs-reference side-by-side @393 (header + 2-line subtitle + card with 2-line title, 2-line desc, tertiary CTA, no card row — faithful). New file per split policy: features/v2-home/ components/sections/PajeuSection.tsx. The old generic ServiceSection placeholder is now unused (superseded, kept per Rule 1 — ฟีม/บอง to decide removal). gate_layer=visual/structure.
